title: Disable task sync per project with an explicit user action
outcome: Disable task sync per project with an explicit user action
acceptance: An explicit per-project disable action turns task sync off; after it, no export, import or sync activity runs for that project until an explicit enable, and the host-consumable state read reports it disabled with its one-line effect description.
Disable changes no repository files, Git index, branch or remote, and leaves exported task text and SQLite work rows intact; re-enabling is an explicit user action and no path re-enables implicitly.
disposal_reason: Superseded by Greg's decision (Engram::Advisor #1278, 2026-10-12 18:44Z): TermAl owns and writes the per-project task-sync opt-in setting, so disabling is TermAl's UI action (TermAl w-00d47e03640f). Engram's side, refusing all sync activity while the setting is not enabled, is B2 w-545ea9accbf0 criterion 4.
